entities.name: Siegbert Hummel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Siegbert Hummel was a German Tibetologist and cultural historian. His work focused on the Eurasian context of Tibetan culture, the Bön religion, the Zhangzhung language, and the Gesar epic.
